verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud documents a usage-based billing model built on Request Units that scale to zero, plus a console monthly cost estimate. However, that estimate extrapolates from observed workload after deployment rather than from published rates before committing. The evidence pack shows no actual per-unit prices, so a founder could not predict a bill from this evidence alone. Missing for 10: published per-unit prices for compute/RUs, storage and data transfer/egress, a pre-commitment pricing calculator, and independent corroboration of bill predictability.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing for compute, storage, and traffic lets me predict my bill before committing

citations.quote: Request Unit consumption scales to zero when your cluster has no activity.
understand your CockroachDB Standard cluster's Request Unit (RU) consumption and tune your workload to balance performance and costs
The monthly cost estimate is calculated using simple extrapolation that assumes your workload during the selected time frame is an accurate representation of your workload over the month.
